content: HTMLTextAreaElement: readOnly property - Web APIs | MDN: The readOnly property of the HTMLTextAreaElement interface indicates that the user cannot modify the value of the control. Unlike the disabled attribute, the readonly attribute does not prevent the user from clicking or selecting in the control. Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).
conclusion: 在严重回插失败等极端回滚异常时，采用只读 textarea（readonly 属性）呈现已捕获的用户草稿全文，允许用户点击并手动选中复制，且纯文本赋值杜绝 HTML 注入，无需剪贴板权限或外部存储。
